import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

# Define paths based on task requirements
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Get all species names from sample submission to ensure correct column headers
species_cols = sample_submission.columns[1:].tolist()
print(f"Number of species: {len(species_cols)}")
print(f"Species class order: {species_cols[:5]}...{species_cols[-5:]}")

# Identify feature columns consistently
train_feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
test_feature_cols = [col for col in test_df.columns if col != "id"]

print(f"Feature columns in train: {len(train_feature_cols)}")
print(f"Feature columns in test: {len(test_feature_cols)}")

# Verify feature alignment
if set(train_feature_cols) != set(test_feature_cols):
    train_feature_cols = [c for c in train_feature_cols if c in test_feature_cols]
    test_feature_cols = [c for c in test_feature_cols if c in train_feature_cols]
    print(
        f"After alignment - Train features: {len(train_feature_cols)}, Test features: {len(test_feature_cols)}"
    )

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df[train_feature_cols]
y_train = train_df["species"]
X_test = test_df[test_feature_cols]

# Create a valid hold-out validation split with stratification
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"\nTrain split: {len(X_train_val)} samples")
print(f"Validation split: {len(X_val)} samples")
print(f"Test set: {len(X_test)} samples")
print(f"Unique classes in train: {len(y_train.unique())}")
print(f"Unique classes in val: {len(y_val.unique())}")

# Train Random Forest Model with balanced class weights
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=10, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, class_weight="balanced"
)

print("\nTraining Random Forest model...")
model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
y_val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Verify model classes match expected species count
print(f"Model classes: {model.classes_}")
print(f"Number of model classes: {len(model.classes_)}")
print(f"Expected species count: {len(species_cols)}")

# Clip probabilities to avoid log(0) issues
y_val_probs_clipped = np.clip(y_val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Calculate log_loss using the same class labels as submission
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_probs_clipped, labels=range(len(species_cols)))
print(f"Validation LogLoss (Hold-out): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Ensure predictions match species_cols order
model_classes = model.classes_
class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(model_classes)}

# Create ordered probability array matching species_cols
ordered_test_probs = np.zeros((len(test_probs), len(species_cols)))
for i, species_name in enumerate(species_cols):
    if species_name in class_to_idx:
        ordered_test_probs[:, i] = test_probs[:, class_to_idx[species_name]]
    else:
        # If species not in model classes, set to uniform probability
        ordered_test_probs[:, i] = 1.0 / len(species_cols)

# Ensure all probabilities sum to 1 for each row
row_sums = ordered_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
ordered_test_probs = ordered_test_probs / row_sums
# Clip again after normalization
ordered_test_probs = np.clip(ordered_test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Final validation: check probability matrix
print(f"Prediction matrix shape: {ordered_test_probs.shape}")
print(f"Probability row sums (first 5): {ordered_test_probs[:5].sum(axis=1)}")
print(
    f"Min/Max probability: {ordered_test_probs.min():.6f} / {ordered_test_probs.max():.6f}"
)

# Create submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(ordered_test_probs, columns=species_cols)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {len(submission_df.columns)}")
print(f"Submission columns (first 10): {list(submission_df.columns[:10])}")
print(f"Submission IDs (first 5): {list(submission_df['id'].head())}")
